name: Slate
description: The workspace: notes, subscriptions and product metrics in one place.
notes: Drag note tabs to put them in any order
Right-click and select text on Coverage, Suggested and in the chat, with Add to chat
Logos for Apple Developer, company registration and Coddy, and logos that no longer go missing
Round checkboxes in notes, and text that fades softly at the top and bottom
Suggested shows what it is doing while it prepares, and links the notes it names
Drag the assistant wider or narrower, and name it in a short first-time setup
